resources.string: Sign in with your PwC email. A code arrives in Teams.
No offices yet. Your admin adds them on the web, or suggest one in developer settings.
Set by your admin. Read-only on the phone.
Share my presence with colleagues who also opted in. Shared: In or Out, since when, and the office name. Not shared: live GPS, coordinates, hours, or points. You can turn this off at any time.
Using more than one phone? Sign in on each. The latest location from any of your phones wins, and a day counts once no matter how many phones saw it.

Use Android Developer options → Select mock location app. Set coordinates inside an office fence, then outside it. Tap Check now above (or wait for a sample) to flip In and Out. Geofence re-register helps if offices changed.
